records.title: Construction and Culture
records.text: CM 250 Construction and Culture (5) A&H Evolution of building construction through history, cultures, economies, and institutions. Explores roles of people in building construction, with emphasis on the roles of owner, builder, and designer through history up to the present time. Focuses on worldwide projects and the people who built them in the context of cultural, economic, scientific, technological, and professional developments of the era. Offered: AWSp.
